answer: Full reward requires answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 41%. Because the trellis pair is tracked in the quartz ledger, the garden audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 168 identities means 168 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
